[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended running apps:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Strava: GPS tracking, pace analysis, route mapping, social component.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Runkeeper: Detailed route tracking, pace monitoring, audio cues, integrates with wearable devices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Nike Run Club: GPS tracking, personalized coaching, customizable workouts, social aspect.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. MapMyRun: GPS tracking, route mapping, pace analysis, integrates with wearable devices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Garmin Connect: Advanced tracking features, customizable data screens, integrates with Garmin devices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Runtastic: GPS tracking, pace analysis, customizable workouts, built-in music player.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Google Fit: GPS tracking, pace monitoring, integrates with Google services.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] All apps are available for iOS and Android, many offer free versions or trials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Before running, user should download and install the app, create an account, familiarize with features, bring phone and gear, and stay hydrated.  
[EVENT] User has been using the Adidas Ultraboost 22 for daily runs.  
[PREFERENCE] User finds the Adidas Ultraboost 22 super comfortable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a step-by-step guide on how to clean and maintain the Adidas Ultraboost 22:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Remove insoles and laces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Brush off dirt and debris with a soft-bristled brush or cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Mix a cleaning solution of 1 tablespoon mild soap with 1 cup warm water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Dampen a cloth with the solution and wipe down the shoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Focus on high-wear areas like the toe box, midsole, and outsole.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Rinse with a clean damp cloth to remove soap residue.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Air dry at room temperature, avoiding direct sunlight or heat.
